canonical_name: Transaction and Function Access Not Controlled
description: Access to security-relevant transactions and system functions is not restricted based on user roles or authorization levels. This signal indicates that users may execute sensitive operations without appropriate access controls.
applicability: Applicable to all systems with security-relevant functions. Includes administrative interfaces, configuration management systems, security tool access, and transaction processing systems.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through role-based access control review, function-level authorization testing, and transaction access audit.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
